latitude.title: Latitude (for a single location)
latitude.description: Leave the Locations (multiple) field below empty to use this single-location shortcut instead. US locations only.

longitude.title: Longitude (for a single location)
longitude.description: Only used together with Latitude above.

label.title: Label (optional)
label.description: Optional display name for the single location above, e.g. "Austin, TX".

locations.title: Locations (multiple)
locations.description: For briefing several locations in one run instead of one at a time. `{ "label": "optional name", "latitude": 30.2672, "longitude": -97.7431 }`. Ignored if Latitude above is filled in.

forecastPeriods.title: Forecast periods
forecastPeriods.description: How many ~12-hour NWS forecast periods to include per location (4 ≈ next 2 days).
